headline: Inde Navarrette joins Marvel's X-Men reboot
post:
Hey everyone! We have some major Marvel casting news to share with you all today. According to The Hollywood Reporter, Inde Navarrette made her hosting debut on Saturday Night Live and shared an exciting update during her monologue about her upcoming project. The actress mentioned that "I’m gonna be in a Marvel movie" and confirmed that she will be portraying Rogue in Marvel Studios’ X-Men reboot! 🎬

During her opening, she talked about how playing the mutant character requires a lot of working out to get fit for the role. It is so cool to see her step into the Marvel Cinematic Universe after her breakout success in the horror hit Obsession, which made massive waves at the box office earlier this year. She will also star in Apple Original Films' The Waffle House Index.

Tom Hanks also made a surprise appearance as David S. Pumpkins during the episode, adding to a wild night of sketches. Are you excited to see her play Rogue on the big screen? 🦸‍♀️

#IndeNavarrette #XMen #MarvelStudios
original_title: ‘SNL’: Inde Navarrette Digs at Shane Gillis’ Joke About Women Dressing Like “Whores” at the Gym as Tom Hanks Crashes Cold Open

headline: Superman: The Stranger changes first power
post:
Hey everyone! Superman's iconic history is getting a fascinating shift. According to Screen Rant, "Superman: The Stranger" is reimagining the hero's classic origins in a unique way. Instead of Herculean strength appearing first, his durability is actually the earliest ability to surface. 

In this Depression-era story, Clark Kent reflects on growing up at Saint Mary's Orphan Asylum. Issue #3 shows that an orphanage bully named George ended up breaking his own hand trying to hit Clark. Clark himself confirms that this resilience appeared before his strength or speed. 

However, this darker twist comes with heartbreak. While he could survive dangerous situations, he lacked the strength to open doors and save coworkers during a tragic factory fire. It is a very different kind of journey for the Man of Steel. ⚡

What do you think of this origin twist?

#Superman #DCComics #Superheroes
original_title: After 88 Years, Superman Just Changed Which Power He Discovered First
